epic.description:
## Overview
Comprehensive UI/UX improvements to transform Ovo Focus into a polished, production-ready mobile experience.

## Objectives
- Improve visual hierarchy and design consistency
- Enhance accessibility for all users
- Optimize performance and animations
- Create a premium, engaging user experience

## Scope
- Visual Design System refinement
- Home Screen improvements
- Collection Screen overhaul
- Settings Screen improvements
- Animation and transition polish
- Accessibility improvements
- Performance optimization
- Advanced UX features

## Success Criteria
- Maintain 60fps during all animations
- Pass WCAG AA accessibility audit
- Positive user feedback on visual improvements
- Improved session completion rate

tickets.summary: Implement responsive typography system with scaling
tickets.description:
## Context
Timer font (72px) can overflow on smaller screens, rarity badges use 8px text that's hard to read, and font weights are inconsistent.

## Requirements
- Implement responsive typography scaling based on screen size
- Increase minimum readable text size to 10px
- Create explicit typography scale: display, headline, title, body, caption, micro
- Add letter-spacing adjustments for improved readability

## Technical Details
- Update src/styles/theme.ts with responsive typography tokens
- Use React Native's PixelRatio or Dimensions for scaling
- Test on screens 320px-428px wide

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Typography scales smoothly on screens 320px-428px wide
- [ ] All text passes WCAG AA contrast requirements
- [ ] Timer remains readable without overflow on all supported devices
- [ ] Typography scale documented in theme.ts

tickets.summary: Add semantic color tokens and enhance color system
tickets.description:
## Context
Limited color palette for UI states, no semantic color tokens for success/warning/error/info.

## Requirements
- Add semantic color tokens: success (#4CAF50), warning (#FF9800), error (#F44336), info (#2196F3)
- Create color variations: light, default, dark for each primary color
- Improve rarity color contrast for accessibility
- Add surface elevation colors (surface1, surface2, surface3)

## Technical Details
- Update src/styles/theme.ts colors object
- Ensure all rarity colors pass 4.5:1 contrast ratio against backgrounds
- Document color usage guidelines

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Semantic colors defined and exported from theme.ts
- [ ] All rarity colors pass 4.5:1 contrast ratio
- [ ] Surface elevation creates clear visual hierarchy
- [ ] Color system documented

tickets.summary: Audit and fix spacing consistency across all components
tickets.description:
## Context
Some components have inconsistent padding, screen margins vary, and touch targets are occasionally below 44px minimum.

## Requirements
- Audit all components for spacing consistency
- Implement 8px grid system strictly
- Ensure all interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets
- Standardize screen padding (16px horizontal, 24px vertical)

## Technical Details
- Review all components in src/components/
- Update theme.ts spacing scale if needed
- Add hitSlop to buttons/touchables where needed

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All touch targets >= 44x44px
- [ ] Consistent 8px grid alignment
- [ ] Screen padding standardized across all views
- [ ] No spacing inconsistencies visible

tickets.summary: Redesign home screen header with clear visual hierarchy
tickets.description:
## Context
Three competing elements in header: collection link, streak badge, daily ring + settings. No clear visual hierarchy and elements feel cramped.

## Requirements
- Redesign header with clear primary/secondary grouping
- Move streak badge to more prominent position or integrate with stats
- Simplify daily progress indicator
- Add subtle separator or background treatment
- Consider collapsing to icon-only on scroll

## Technical Details
- Update app/index.tsx header section
- May need new HeaderBar component
- Coordinate with stats bar redesign

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Clear visual hierarchy with one primary focal point
- [ ] Header elements have appropriate spacing (min 12px between elements)
- [ ] Touch targets adequate for all header buttons
- [ ] Header looks balanced and intentional

tickets.summary: Enhance timer display with progress ring and visual feedback
tickets.description:
## Context
Plain text timer display could be more engaging, no visual progress indication beyond text, pause state not visually distinct.

## Requirements
- Add circular progress ring around timer
- Implement color transitions as session progresses
- Create distinct visual treatment for paused state (dimmed, pulsing border)
- Add subtle glow effect that intensifies with progress
- Consider session phase indicators (warm-up, focus, finishing)

## Technical Details
- Create new TimerRing component using react-native-svg or Reanimated
- Integrate with existing timer state from GameContext
- Use Reanimated for smooth color transitions

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Progress ring accurately reflects session progress (0-100%)
- [ ] Paused state is immediately recognizable
- [ ] Smooth color transitions without jank (60fps)
- [ ] Glow intensity correlates with progress

tickets.summary: Redesign session controls with improved button hierarchy
tickets.description:
## Context
Controls at bottom could be more prominent, give up button placement could lead to accidental taps, pause count indicator is subtle.

## Requirements
- Create floating action bar with clear button hierarchy
- Add safe distance between destructive (give up) and constructive actions
- Make pause count indicator more prominent with visual badges
- Add micro-animations on button state changes
- Consider swipe gestures for common actions

## Technical Details
- Create SessionControls component
- Update PixelButton for new variants if needed
- Implement swipe gesture with react-native-gesture-handler

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Primary action (start/pause/resume) is most prominent
- [ ] Destructive actions require deliberate interaction (separated by > 24px)
- [ ] Pause count clearly visible at all times
- [ ] Button state changes have micro-animations

tickets.summary: Add screen transition animations for modals
tickets.description:
## Context
Modals appear instantly without animation, screen changes feel abrupt.

## Requirements
- Add slide-up animation for modals (collection, settings)
- Implement crossfade for screen content changes
- Create state transition animations (idle → active → completed)
- Add parallax effect on scroll
- Implement shared element transitions where appropriate

## Technical Details
- Use Expo Router's animation options
- Create custom modal wrapper with Reanimated
- Test on both iOS and Android

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All modals have entrance/exit animations
- [ ] State changes feel smooth and intentional
- [ ] Animations complete within 300ms
- [ ] No animation jank or dropped frames

tickets.summary: Implement screen reader support and accessibility labels
tickets.description:
## Context
Accessibility labels may be incomplete, focus order might not be logical, announcements for state changes missing.

## Requirements
- Audit all components for accessibilityLabel
- Implement logical focus order (tab navigation)
- Add announcements for session state changes
- Ensure all images have alt text
- Test with VoiceOver and TalkBack

## Technical Details
- Add accessibilityLabel, accessibilityHint, accessibilityRole to all components
- Use AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility for state changes
- Set accessibilityElementsHidden for decorative elements

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] App fully navigable with screen reader
- [ ] State changes announced appropriately
- [ ] All interactive elements have descriptive labels
- [ ] Tested on both VoiceOver (iOS) and TalkBack (Android)

tickets.summary: Unify filter and sort UI with consistent styling
tickets.description:
## Context
Filter chips have inconsistent styling (filled vs outlined), sort options not immediately discoverable, no visual indication of active filters.

## Requirements
- Unify chip styling: all outlined, filled when active
- Add filter badge showing count of active filters
- Create slide-out or bottom sheet for advanced filtering
- Add 'Clear all filters' quick action
- Persist filter preferences across sessions

## Technical Details
- Update FilterChip component styling
- Add AsyncStorage persistence for filters
- Create FilterSheet component for advanced options

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Consistent chip styling throughout (outlined default, filled active)
- [ ] Active filter state clearly indicated with badge
- [ ] Filters persist between app sessions
- [ ] Clear all filters available when filters active

tickets.summary: Optimize collection grid with virtualization and collapsible sections
tickets.description:
## Context
No virtualization for large collections, staggered animations can feel slow with many items, rarity sections cannot collapse.

## Requirements
- Implement FlashList for virtualized rendering
- Add collapsible rarity sections with expand/collapse
- Reduce animation stagger for collections > 20 items
- Add 'scroll to top' button when scrolled
- Implement pull-to-refresh for collection sync

## Technical Details
- Replace FlatList with @shopify/flash-list
- Create CollapsibleSection component
- Add scroll position tracking for 'scroll to top' button

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth 60fps scrolling with 100+ animals
- [ ] Rarity sections collapsible with animation
- [ ] Quick navigation for large collections
- [ ] Scroll to top appears after scrolling 500px

tickets.summary: Redesign animal cards with enhanced visuals and clear progression
tickets.description:
## Context
Emoji-only design may feel basic, level dots are subtle and hard to see, count badges crowd the card.

## Requirements
- Create custom animal illustrations or enhance emoji with backgrounds
- Redesign level indicator as progress bar or stars
- Move count to detail view, show 'collected' checkmark on card
- Add rarity-colored card borders or backgrounds
- Implement card flip animation for reveal
- Add shimmer loading state

## Technical Details
- Create new AnimalCard design in Figma first
- Update src/components/AnimalCard.tsx
- Add shimmer placeholder component
- Consider SVG backgrounds for animals

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cards feel premium and polished
- [ ] Level progression clearly visible (progress bar or stars)
- [ ] Rarity immediately identifiable without reading badge
- [ ] Card flip animation smooth and satisfying
- [ ] Shimmer loading state implemented

tickets.summary: Create illustrated empty and error states
tickets.description:
## Context
Empty state uses only emoji + text, no error state designs, loading state not implemented.

## Requirements
- Create illustrated empty states for each filter combination
- Design error state with retry action
- Add skeleton loading screens
- Implement friendly 'no results' state with suggestions
- Add celebration state when collection complete

## Technical Details
- Create EmptyState component variants
- Create SkeletonCard component
- Add error boundary with custom fallback

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every state has thoughtful design
- [ ] Error states provide clear recovery path (retry button)
- [ ] Loading feels fast with skeleton screens
- [ ] Celebration triggers at 100% collection

tickets.summary: Improve egg interaction feedback and gesture discovery
tickets.description:
## Context
Gesture hints only shown once, feedback messages could be more engaging, long press detection sometimes conflicts with scroll.

## Requirements
- Add persistent subtle hint for available interactions
- Create variety of encouragement messages (10+ variations)
- Implement haptic patterns that correspond to message types
- Add visual feedback ripple on each interaction
- Show interaction count or engagement meter

## Technical Details
- Update src/components/Egg.tsx interaction handling
- Create message pool in src/data/ or src/i18n/
- Add ripple effect component

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users discover all three gesture types naturally
- [ ] 10+ unique encouragement messages (per language)
- [ ] Haptic feedback matches interaction type
- [ ] Visual ripple on each interaction

tickets.summary: Redesign stats bar with compact pills and trends
tickets.description:
## Context
Stats feel disconnected from main focus, 'BEST' badge could be more celebratory, limited information density.

## Requirements
- Create compact stat pills with icons
- Add mini-trends (up/down arrows for streak changes)
- Animate 'BEST' badge when achieved
- Consider expandable stats view on tap
- Add today's focus time as primary stat

## Technical Details
- Create StatPill component
- Add trend calculation to GameContext
- Create expandable stats modal or sheet

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Stats immediately comprehensible with icons
- [ ] 'BEST' achievement feels rewarding (animation + haptic)
- [ ] Tapping stats reveals detailed view
- [ ] Today's focus time prominently displayed

tickets.summary: Refine micro-interactions and button feedback
tickets.description:
## Context
Some buttons lack press feedback, toggle animations could be snappier, success/failure states need polish.

## Requirements
- Audit all interactive elements for feedback
- Add satisfying toggle animations with overshoot
- Create success checkmark animation
- Add failure shake animation
- Implement button ripple effects

## Technical Details
- Update PixelButton with ripple
- Create ToggleSwitch with custom animation
- Add success/failure feedback components

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every interaction has immediate feedback (< 100ms)
- [ ] Toggle animations feel satisfying with spring overshoot
- [ ] Success/failure clearly communicated visually
- [ ] Ripple effect on button press

tickets.summary: Implement loading and progress state indicators
tickets.description:
## Context
No loading indicators during data operations, progress not shown during session save, app feels frozen during heavy operations.

## Requirements
- Add subtle loading spinner for async operations
- Show save progress indicator
- Implement optimistic UI updates
- Add skeleton screens for initial load
- Create progress indicators for long operations

## Technical Details
- Create LoadingIndicator component
- Implement optimistic updates in GameContext
- Add loading states to relevant screens

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users always know app is working (loading indicator)
- [ ] No perceived 'freezing' during operations
- [ ] Operations feel fast with optimistic updates
- [ ] Initial load uses skeleton screens

tickets.summary: Audit and fix color contrast for WCAG AA compliance
tickets.description:
## Context
Some text may not meet contrast requirements, no high contrast mode, color-only indicators (rarity colors).

## Requirements
- Audit all text for WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1)
- Add patterns or icons alongside color coding
- Implement optional high contrast theme
- Ensure focus indicators are visible
- Test with color blindness simulators

## Technical Details
- Use contrast checking tools to audit
- Add rarity icons in addition to colors
- Create highContrast theme variant

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All text passes WCAG AA (4.5:1 contrast ratio)
- [ ] Information not conveyed by color alone
- [ ] High contrast option available in settings
- [ ] Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements

tickets.summary: Enhance animal detail modal with animations and history
tickets.description:
## Context
Modal appears without transition, limited information displayed, favorite toggle could be more prominent.

## Requirements
- Add slide-up or scale entrance animation
- Display collection history (dates, total count)
- Show animal 'personality' or fun facts
- Make favorite button more prominent with animation
- Add share functionality for collected animals
- Show 'time to next level' for leveling system

## Technical Details
- Update AnimalDetailModal component
- Add collection history to animal data model if needed
- Implement share with expo-sharing

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Modal has smooth entrance/exit animations
- [ ] All relevant animal data displayed (history, facts)
- [ ] Favorite action feels satisfying with animation
- [ ] Share generates shareable image/link

tickets.summary: Reorganize settings screen with icons and sections
tickets.description:
## Context
Sections could be better grouped, focus duration buttons don't adapt to screen width, statistics are plain text.

## Requirements
- Reorganize into clear categories: Session, Notifications, Preferences, Data
- Use segmented control or slider for focus duration
- Add icons to each setting for quick scanning
- Create visual stats cards with mini-charts
- Add search/filter for settings

## Technical Details
- Restructure app/settings.tsx
- Create SettingsSection component
- Add icons from expo/vector-icons

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Settings logically grouped with clear headers
- [ ] All controls adapt to screen width
- [ ] Icons aid quick comprehension
- [ ] Focus duration uses slider or segmented control

tickets.summary: Optimize animation performance and battery usage
tickets.description:
## Context
Multiple simultaneous animations on egg, infinite animations drain battery, confetti particles not cleaned up immediately.

## Requirements
- Implement animation budgeting (max concurrent animations)
- Pause animations when app backgrounded
- Clean up particles immediately after fade
- Use native driver for all animations
- Profile and optimize heavy animations

## Technical Details
- Add AppState listener to pause animations
- Audit all Reanimated animations for useNativeDriver
- Implement animation manager/coordinator
- Profile with Flipper or React DevTools

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Consistent 60fps during animations
- [ ] Battery usage reduced when idle/backgrounded
- [ ] No memory leaks from animations
- [ ] All animations use native driver where possible

tickets.summary: Create guided onboarding flow for new users
tickets.description:
## Context
No guided onboarding, gesture hints only shown once, features may be undiscoverable.

## Requirements
- Create 3-5 screen onboarding carousel
- Implement progressive disclosure for features
- Add 'tips' system for advanced features
- Create interactive tutorials for gestures
- Show 'what's new' after updates

## Technical Details
- Create OnboardingScreen component
- Store onboarding completion in AsyncStorage
- Track app version for 'what's new' display

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New users complete onboarding in < 1 minute
- [ ] Core features understood before first session
- [ ] Tips appear contextually (not overwhelming)
- [ ] What's new shown after app updates

tickets.summary: Implement reduced motion support
tickets.description:
## Context
No reduced motion support, animations might trigger vestibular issues, particle effects could be overwhelming.

## Requirements
- Detect and respect 'reduce motion' system setting
- Provide fallback static states for all animations
- Allow disabling particle effects in settings
- Reduce or eliminate auto-playing animations
- Test with reduced motion enabled

## Technical Details
- Use AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled()
- Create animation wrappers that respect setting
- Add particle toggle in settings

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Respects system reduce motion preference
- [ ] Alternative static designs work well
- [ ] User can disable specific animation types in settings
- [ ] Tested with reduced motion enabled

tickets.summary: Optimize render performance with memoization
tickets.description:
## Context
Collection may re-render unnecessarily, no memoization audit, heavy component tree.

## Requirements
- Implement React.memo for pure components
- Add useMemo/useCallback where appropriate
- Split large components into smaller chunks
- Implement lazy loading for modals
- Profile renders with React DevTools

## Technical Details
- Audit all components for unnecessary re-renders
- Use React.memo, useMemo, useCallback appropriately
- Add React.lazy for modal components

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Reduced re-renders on state changes (measurable)
- [ ] Modals load on-demand
- [ ] Measurable performance improvement (profile before/after)
- [ ] No regressions in functionality

tickets.summary: Redesign danger zone with proper confirmation flow
tickets.description:
## Context
Delete button doesn't feel appropriately serious, no intermediate confirmation steps.

## Requirements
- Add visual warning treatment (red border, warning icon)
- Implement two-step deletion (type 'DELETE' to confirm)
- Show what will be lost before deletion
- Add export data option before delete
- Consider 'soft delete' with 7-day recovery

## Technical Details
- Create DangerZone component
- Implement text confirmation input
- Add data export using expo-sharing

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Deletion feels appropriately serious (visual treatment)
- [ ] Users understand consequences before action (preview)
- [ ] Two-step confirmation required (type DELETE)
- [ ] Export option available before delete

tickets.summary: Add milestone celebrations and achievement system
tickets.description:
## Context
Limited positive reinforcement, no milestone celebrations, streaks feel underwhelming.

## Requirements
- Add milestone celebrations (10, 50, 100 sessions)
- Create 'achievement unlocked' animations
- Implement streak milestones with special rewards
- Add weekly summary with encouragement
- Create share cards for achievements

## Technical Details
- Create AchievementModal component
- Track milestones in GameContext
- Generate share images with expo-view-shot

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Milestones trigger celebratory UI (confetti, modal)
- [ ] Users feel recognized for progress
- [ ] Shareable achievement cards can be generated
- [ ] Weekly summary shows at appropriate time
